title: Project
description: A project of the issue tracker. A repository belongs to at most one project (D116).

approvalGuidelines.description: Markdown of the user: which issue needs the approval of the user, and which one an agent works on its own. In by_issue, an agent chooses the approval of a new issue by it (D129).

repositories.description: The names of the repositories of the project that the caller sees, as in Repository.name, in name order.
